name: The Eternal Adventures of Tits Magee
source:
A dame walks into Tits Magee's office and gives her a murder case to solve. You would think as a detective this would happen more often, but hey, times are hard. Solving murders is harder. Time to find the culprit or die trying.

[From [url=https://ghostsontv.itch.io/the-eternal-adventures-of-tits-magee]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位女士走进蒂茨·马吉的办公室，交给她一桩谋杀案来侦破。你可能会认为作为一名侦探，这种情况会更频繁地发生，但是嘿，时代很艰难。侦破谋杀案更加困难。是时候找到罪魁祸首了，否则就死定了。

[来自[url=https://ghostsontv.itch.io/the-eternal-adventures-of-tits-magee]Itch.io[/url]]
